text:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: rwinf-504 spike. Auto-pager cleared at 2024-11-20T15:22Z. Please confirm next steps for PIR scheduling.

Maria Chen: thanks — quick check: did we capture customer impact in the incident doc? link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/rwinf-504-spike

Kevin Patel: yep added customer timelines + affected tenants section. i'll ping infra for the metrics graphs.

Samira Ali: I'm +1 on running the PIR but out thurs/fri next week. can do Tues/Wed mornings PST.

Lee Wong: I can facilitate if Maria is busy. mornings work best for me (PDT).

Maria Chen: leaning towards Kevin facilitating (he owned the mitigation). Kevin?

Kevin Patel: i can facilitate but prefer to co-host with someone who wasn't deep in the firefight — Samira would be good. if Samira can, i'm ok taking notes.

Samira Ali: happy to co-host. i can prep the timeline and write the pre-read. who should I include on the pre-read?

Emily Park: product and support ops should get the pre-read: @support, @product-ux. also include the affected-customer PM (i'll DM the contact).

Jared: heads up — timezone coverage: EMEA folks are unavailable Tue morning PST. Wed 16:00 UTC (9am PST) works for most EMEA folks.

Maria Chen: propose two options: Wed 09:00 PST (16:00 UTC) or Thu 08:00 PST (15:00 UTC). I'll drop a tiny Doodle.

oncall-bot: calendar-note created: "PIR — rwinf-504 spike" draft event (pending organizer confirmation).

Kevin Patel: pinging folks: please mark availability in the poll by EOD today. we want to run PIR next week to avoid blocking rollout tasks.

Samira Ali: new action: Samira -> create pre-read in docs (template: /templates/pir-pre-read.md) by Tue 12:00 PST.

Lee Wong: action: Lee -> collect KV cache metrics and attach graphs to the pre-read (ticket INF-3124). ETA Tue EOD.

Emily Park: action: Emily -> notify support + product and add affected-customer PM to invite. ETA Tue EOD.

Kevin Patel: i will own facilitation if Samira co-hosts. i'll draft the agenda: quick timeline (10m), mitigation decisions (15m), root cause hypotheses (20m), action reviews (15m).

Maria Chen: also add a 'fallthrough' plan item: who owns follow-up if someone is OOO. assign backups.

Samira Ali: i put a short runbook snippet into the pre-read draft. code block: ```bash
# quick KV cache flush check
redis-cli -h cache.redwood.internal INFO | grep keyspace
```

Maria Chen: assigning facilitator slot: Samira (co-host) + Kevin (notes/facil) for Wed 09:00 PST unless poll says otherwise. if either can't, Lee is backup.

IncidentBot: reaction :thumbsup: from Maria Chen, Kevin Patel.

Jared: calendar invite send plan: Maria will create event and set organizer=Samira, add 'notes' doc link and pre-read. please RSVP ASAP.

Maria Chen: will create event by EOD and tag action owners on the doc. Thanks everyone.

Kevin Patel: one more — add a short 'severity-to-customer-impact mapping' slide in pre-read (i'll drop a template).

Samira Ali: noted. adding items to the doc now.

Emily Park: FYI, customer comms follow-up — i'll draft a short status email after PIR; capture any timeline changes.

Maria Chen: last call for attendees — if you're oncall but cannot attend, please add your delegate in the doc.

Kevin Patel: ack. leaving a checkbox list in the pre-read for delegates.

Samira Ali: closing loop: pre-read link (draft): https://redwood.internal/docs/pir/rwinf-504-pre-read-draft. will update with graphs when Lee uploads.

oncall-bot: THREAD LOCKED: reminders set for poll + calendar.

Maria Chen: thanks team, we'll reconvene after invites are out and confirm facilitator assignment in-thread. :wave:
